2608.07243.title: Recipes for Creativity: Iterative Generation and Evaluation in Large Language Models
2608.07243.paper_summary: Generative models are often evaluated through singular artifacts, whereas human creativity typically emerges through iterative generation, appraisal, and refinement. This pilot study examines whether iterative search improves LLM creativity by adapting FunSearch to recipe generation for the 2024 Pillsbury Bake-Off and evaluating outputs against human benchmarks using TTCT-based LLM evaluation. Across two experiments, we test iteration count, generator temperature, and in-loop selection-scorer model size. Results show that iterative generation-selection can produce recipes with creativity scores comparable to human benchmarks, but additional iterations alone do not improve creativity. The in-loop evaluator matters most: a smaller selection scorer yields significantly higher scores across most TTCT dimensions, while temperature has limited effects except for originality. These findings suggest that evaluator design is a first-order design variable in subjective creative search.
2608.07243.paper_summary_zh: 生成模型通常通過單一的產物來評估，而人類創造力則通常通過反覆生成、評估和完善來表現。這項初步研究檢視了反覆搜尋是否能透過將 FunSearch 調整為 2024 年 Pillsbury Bake-Off 的食譜生成來提升 LLM 的創造力，並使用基於 TTCT 的 LLM 評估來評估輸出與人類基準的對比。在兩個實驗中，我們測試了迭代次數、生成器溫度和迴圈內選擇評分模型的大小。結果顯示，反覆生成-選擇可以產生創造力得分與人類基準相當的食譜，但僅僅增加迭代次數並不會提升創造力。迴圈內的評估者最為重要：較小的選擇評分器在大多數 TTCT 維度上產生顯著更高的得分，而溫度的影響有限，除了在原創性方面。這些發現表明，評估者設計是主觀創意搜尋中的一個首要設計變數。
